title: The killing floor
premise: You come back to a room you already made a mess of.

stages.narration: You know this floor. You made it. The bodies you put down are where you left them and the smell has thickened into something with weight to it — and the smell is the part that carries. Whatever finds this place next will find it because of what you did here.

choices.label: Drag them out of the room and out of the doorway
Take what you came for and don't look down

notes: T84. The first authored use of minCorpses/minBlood — both fields were seeded and never written before T84 (design review signal ledger: 'corpses / blood — dead'), so this beat was unreachable content the day it would have been written. It fires only at a node the PLAYER has fought over (nothing else writes corpses), only while the room is quiet again (maxWalkers 0), and only while the blood has not yet faded (BLOOD_DECAY_PER_HOUR 2), which makes it a beat about consequence rather than scenery. Part-closes PL-M5-03 (minBlood/minCorpses unused by content).
